priceSnapshot.note: TIMING DISCLOSURE FIRST, because it conditions everything below. This is the MIDDAY session and its nominal slot is 12:40 COT, but the run did not execute until 23:51 COT on 20 September - roughly eleven hours late - and it is the first session to run since Friday evening's endday. The 19 September day produced no reports at all and 20 September produced no midnight and no morning. So the comparison this report owes you is not against today's morning file, which does not exist; it is against 2026-09-18-endday, and it covers a 52-hour gap rather than the usual six. Treat the bias review accordingly: two full days of tape are being judged in one pass. Price is 81,483.5, up 1.36 percent on the 24-hour open of 80,391.1 and 218.6 points above Friday's endday handover at 81,264.9. Across 52 hours that is a net advance of 0.27 percent, which is the single most important fact in this file: the market went a very long way and arrived almost nowhere. The Bogota day spanned 80,173.5 to 82,099.0, a 1,925.5-point range and 2.36 percent of price, and both extremes were made in the last twenty-four hours. Friday's unresolved question - whether 81,267.0 was a pause or a ceiling - has been answered in both directions and then unanswered again.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 80,750.0, RAISED 181.4 points from the 80,568.6 that Friday published and that DID fire. 80,750.0 is the second of the two realized long-liquidation shelves on tonight's OKX tape (140,760 USD of fills) and it sits 576.6 points under the 81,000 shelf that was consumed and reclaimed in the small hours. It is 733.5 points under the mark, 1.74 times the 422.51-point 1H ATR14 - deliberately wider than this file's usual 1.2-to-1.3 multiple, because the 80,568.6 gate was stopped out at 80,133.4 and price then recovered 1,350 points in under three hours. That is the definition of a stop placed inside the noise, and the correction is to stand further back. The settled-close requirement is unchanged.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 82,099.0, RAISED 832.0 points from Friday's 81,267.0. Friday held that gate because it had been refused four times and never paid for. It has now been PAID FOR - 18 separate settled hourly closes above it since 09-19 01:00 UTC, the first arriving 25 minutes after the endday report went out - and this file's own 17 September lesson is that a trigger which has been paid for is no longer a trigger. The gate therefore moves to the high of the move, 82,099.0, printed at 01:15 UTC tonight. Note what the gate is being asked to overcome: that high came with a 1H RSI of 50.92 against 73.19 at the 81,953.1 high thirty-four hours earlier. A settled close through 82,099.0 would break that divergence rather than confirm it, which is exactly why the bar is set there and not lower.

decisionBox.changed: Bias stays BULLISH and the tilt stays bullish. Probabilities move from 57/27/16 to 54/30/16 and confidence from 6.90 to 6.30 - a downgrade paid for entirely by 52 hours of range rather than trend, and by a 1H bearish divergence that did not exist on Friday. Position moves from TAKE_PROFIT back to ADD. That is a whipsaw and it deserves to be named as one: Friday sold a slice at 81,264.9 and this session buys back 218.6 points higher. What justifies paying up is that three things changed. Friday's ETF print has been revised UP from 322.3 to 433.0 million USD by Farside. The add gate that was refused four times has now settled above eighteen times. And the 81,000 and 80,750 long-liquidation shelves were flushed to 80,133.4 and fully reclaimed within three hours, which is what turns a magnet into a floor. The reduce gate is raised 181.4 points to 80,750.0 because the old one was demonstrably too tight. The 77,167.3 invalidation is UNCHANGED for a fifth consecutive session - it is now 5.30 percent below spot and looks generous, and it stays anyway, because this file does not move a structural level to flatter a position. The resting stop goes back to NOT recommended: the next scheduled run is midnight at roughly 02:00 COT, about two hours away, so there is no overnight gap to protect against.

liquidation.note: 535,136 USD of realized fills, the heaviest bucket on the tape in the 01:51:03 to 04:03:35 UTC window and overwhelmingly LONG liquidations. This is the shelf that broke during the 01:15 to 01:45 UTC flush from 82,099.0 to 80,857.6, and the important word is BROKE - the fuel here has been burned, not banked. Price reclaimed the whole area within two hours and has settled every hour since above 80,990. A consumed long-liquidation cluster that price closes back above stops being a magnet and starts being a floor, which is why it is the anchor of the scalp box rather than a downside target.

140,760 USD of realized long-liquidation fills, the second shelf and the one the reduce gate is now placed at. Same window, same one-sided character. Across the whole 100-fill sample longs were liquidated for 676,415 USD against 90,200 USD of shorts - a 7.5-to-1 tilt AGAINST longs, the exact mirror of Friday's 25.1-to-1 tilt against shorts. Positioning has been washed in both directions inside 52 hours, which is the cleanest single explanation for why the OKX long/short account ratio has collapsed from 1.70-1.80 mid-week to 1.05 now.

86,158 USD of realized fills, predominantly SHORT liquidations, and effectively AT the money - the bucket centre sits 16.5 points under spot. This is shorts being force-covered into the reclaim, and it is the only cluster on the tape that is not a long being stopped out. Small in USD terms next to the 81,000 shelf, so it is noted rather than traded.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP, and the reasoning is about what has been SPENT rather than what is heaviest. On raw weight the map points down: 676,415 USD of long liquidations against 90,200 USD of shorts, and the single biggest bucket sits 483.5 points below spot at 81,000. But that weight is history. It was created during the 01:15 to 01:45 UTC flush, price bottomed 80,133.4 in the Bogota morning and 80,857.6 on the retest, and every settled hour since 02:00 UTC has closed above 80,990. Fuel that has already been consumed does not pull price back to it. What has NOT been worked is above: the 82,099.0 high is 615.5 points away with breakout stops resting over it and no realized cluster between here and there, and the estimated 82,285.0 bracket sits just beyond. So the honest reading is a modest upward pull into thin territory, with the caveat that the pull is inferred from the absence of resistance rather than measured from a cluster - and that the 1H divergence argues the market may not have the momentum to reach it.

atr.source: Computed by this session from 299 verified settled OKX 1Dutc candles read in-browser, Wilder smoothing, settled buckets only. Note the daily figure is now computed on UTC-aligned daily buckets rather than OKX's default 16:00 UTC boundary, so it is not directly comparable with Friday's 2,432.61. On the same verified series the 4H ATR14 is 810.53 (0.99 percent), the 1H ATR14 is 422.51 (0.52 percent) and the 15m ATR14 is 238.94 (0.29 percent). Against Friday's readings the 4H is down 15.7 percent from 961.52 and the 1H down 10.7 percent from 472.96, while the 15m is UP 28.1 percent from 186.58. Slow frames compressing while the fastest frame expands is the signature of a market that is coiling on the structure and still whipping inside it.

calibration.note: A 52-hour window in which BOTH of Friday's gates fired, in sequence, and the order is the whole lesson. The ADD gate went first: 81,267.0 required a settled 1H close and got one at 09-19 01:00 UTC closing 81,285.8, exactly 25 minutes after the endday report was published, and then 17 more - 18 settled closes above in total, running as high as 81,838.4. Friday held that gate on the explicit argument that a trigger refused four times is unmet rather than stale, and that call was vindicated within half an hour. The REDUCE gate went second: 80,568.6 was breached on a settled close at 09-20 02:00 UTC at 80,338.7 and stayed broken for 12 settled hours, with the low of the move at 80,133.4 - 435.2 points of overshoot. So priorReduceFired is TRUE. The 77,167.3 invalidation held with 4,316.2 points of clearance, its widest margin yet, for a fourth session. Now the uncomfortable part. Friday recommended a RESTING STOP at 80,568.6 for exactly this gap, and that stop would have been filled near 80,133.4 - after which price recovered 1,350 points in under three hours and is now 914.9 points above the stop. The resting stop was the single worst instruction in the endday file, and the correction is already applied: tonight's reduce gate is 181.4 points wider at 80,750.0 and the resting stop is withdrawn. Directionally the endday was right, barely: it published BULLISH at 81,264.9 and price is 81,483.5, 218.6 points and 0.27 percent higher, which lifts the lifetime line to 101 of 199. Discretionary: the endday SOLD 15 percent of the spot book at 81,264.9, roughly 0.00029065 BTC for 23.62 USDT. That slice would be worth 23.69 USDT now, so the take-profit cost about 0.07 USDT. Marginal, but negative - hence acting_helped FALSE. Two structural notes for the record. First, this run is the MIDDAY session executing at 23:51 COT, about eleven hours late. Second, 19 September produced no reports at all and 20 September produced no midnight and no morning, so the manifest will show three null sessions that were never run rather than three that failed to write.
